library_name: Destiny KOTOR Force Traditions and Sith Expansions
notes: Detailed mechanics for era-valid KOTOR Force traditions and KOTOR Sith-tree additions.

rules.name: Action Exchange
rules.description: A successful Force Delay lets a nearby ally exchange movement for another major action.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On the ally's next turn, that ally may trade its move action for an additional standard action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 57

rules.name: Force Delay
rules.description: Use a Force-assisted verbal shock to deprive an intelligent opponent of an action.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ creature that understands you.
mechanics.effect: On success, target loses its move action on its next turn. If you spend 1 Force Point, it loses its standard action instead.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 57

rules.name: Imbue Item
rules.description: Attune a crafted item so it can store one Force Point for your later use.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.use: Full-round action to imbue the item; full-round action to store a Force Point; swift action to spend the stored point.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to imbue a specially crafted weapon, item, armor, or garment.
mechanics.effect: The attuned item can store one Force Point transferred into it by its wearer; you may later spend that stored point, even in a round when you spend one of your own.
mechanics.special: Attune only one item per 24 hours; it functions only for you; only one attuned item may be worn; one point maximum stored; maximum two Force Points spent in a round, one personal and one stored.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 58

rules.name: Knowledge of the Force
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to assist a nearby ally's Use the Force check as a reaction.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.effect: Use aid another on the ally's Use the Force check, following the normal aid-another rules.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 58

rules.name: Dark Side Manipulation
rules.description: Maximize a Force Point die when spending it as part of an act that earns a Dark Side Point.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point on an act that would give you a Dark Side Point.
mechanics.effect: Treat the Force Point die as though it rolled its maximum value.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 59

rules.name: Krath Illusions
rules.description: Reduce the size penalty when creating large Force illusions.

mechanics.trigger: Create an illusion subject to a size penalty.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the size penalty by half, rounded down, to a minimum penalty of -1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Krath Intuition
rules.description: Maximize the damage of a Sith alchemical weapon once per encounter.

mechanics.trigger: Roll damage with a Sith alchemical weapon.
mechanics.effect: Treat every damage die as though it rolled its maximum value.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Krath Surge
rules.description: Use rudimentary Sith sorcery to increase one Force power's damage or range.

mechanics.effect: Either add one die of damage if the power deals damage, or extend its range by 6 squares if it has a range beyond self or a single-target-only range.
mechanics.special: The affected power automatically gains the dark-side descriptor.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Field Detection
rules.description: Sense nearby energy fields and identify shield fluctuations that your attacks can exploit.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.effect: Detect the presence, general strength, type, and origin or direction of electromagnetic and energy fields within 12 squares, including communications, sensors, and electronics. Against a personal or vehicle shield you damage, a successful check reduces its SR by 5 against your attacks.
mechanics.duration: Shield reduction lasts until end of your turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Improved Force Sight
rules.description: Refine Miralukan Force sight for rapid searching and automatic awareness of surroundings.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.effect: Use the Search application of Perception as a swift action. You automatically succeed on the Sense Surroundings application of Use the Force without rolling.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Luka Sene Master
rules.description: Gain one encounter-limited Force Point dedicated to Luka Sene and perception-related Force abilities.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point usable only to activate a Sense- or Luka Sene-tree talent, activate Farseeing, or modify a Use the Force check for Search Your Feelings or Sense Force.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Quickseeing
rules.description: Sacrifice a Farseeing use to gain brief combat insight against a nearby living creature.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.cost: Remove one Farseeing use from your active Force suite as though activated.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, gain +2 insight on attacks against that target.
mechanics.special: Counts as using Farseeing on the target but replaces the power's normal rules and effect.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Deception Awareness
rules.description: Use the Force to resist and detect deception or outside influence.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Will Defense against Deception. Use Use the Force instead of Perception to sense deception or influence and count as trained in Perception for those uses; qualifying Perception rerolls apply to the substituted check.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Fira)
rules.description: Gain another accuracy bonus with the traditional fira.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on melee attacks with a fira, stacking with Weapon Focus.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Progenitor's Call
rules.description: Invoke ancestral voices to confuse an enemy and impose a persistent condition.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, target moves -1 persistent condition step and loses its standard action on its next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. A creature can be affected only once per encounter. Persistent condition ends after Treat Injury DC 15 or 8 hours of rest.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Waveform
rules.description: Shape environmental particles like an ocean wave to strengthen telekinetic damage.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.use: Swift action when activating a telekinetic Force power.
mechanics.trigger: Use a power affected by Telekinetic Power or Telekinetic Savant.
mechanics.effect: Add Charisma modifier, minimum +1, to any damage the power deals.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Affliction
rules.description: A damaging single-target Force power inflicts delayed Force damage as well.

mechanics.trigger: You damage one opponent with a Force power.
mechanics.effect: At the beginning of that opponent's next turn, before it acts, it takes 2d6 Force damage.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Dark Healing Field
rules.description: Drain life from as many as three nearby creatures and heal from their combined suffering.

mechanics.target: Up to three creatures within 12 squares.
mechanics.check: One Use the Force check compared with each target's Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: Each target whose Fortitude is met takes 1d6 damage per Sith class level; a missed target takes half. You heal half the total damage dealt across all targets.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Drain Force
rules.description: Sap a Force-sensitive enemy's power when you damage them.

mechanics.effect: Regain one spent Force power and cause the target to lose 1 Force Point.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40
